archetype: Organic & Earthy (1) with a touch of Swiss High-Contrast (4) for typography

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-8xl tracking-tighter uppercase leading-none
scale.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight uppercase leading-tight

backgroundImage.texture-grain: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")

layout_and_spacing.grid: Bento-style grids with generous gaps (gap-8 to gap-12).
layout_and_spacing.spacing: Use p-8 to p-16 for main sections. Ensure generous white-space for editorial feel.
layout_and_spacing.corners: Sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) to match the heavy/brutalist structural elements.
layout_and_spacing.clip_path: For hero photo panels, use a slanted clip path (e.g., clip-path: polygon(10% 0, 100% 0, 90% 100%, 0 100%)) or rotate elements slightly.
layout_and_spacing.texture: Subtle grain overlay using the texture-grain background class on a fixed pseudo-element with opacity-50 over the body.

components.promo_bar: Centered text, light grey bg in light mode (dark grey in dark mode), small truck icon. Very subtle.
components.nav: Wordmark centered with orange square logo. Left/Right balanced links. Sharp pill/button for Sign In/Cart.
components.hero: Eyebrow text uppercase tracking wide. H1 massive, black, condensed, with 'BIG' highlighted in accent color. Solid orange CTA and Outline CTA (sharp corners). 4 diagonal photo panels on the right.
components.trust_strip: 5 hand-drawn monoline icons (Lucide or custom SVG) with 1-line label and sub-label. Thin vertical dividers between items. Use Flex with divide-x.
components.category_tiles: Flat cards, no drop shadow. 1px border. Icon + Label + 'Shop Now ->' in accent color. Hover: border accent color, slight bg tint.
components.built_different: H2 left aligned, large. Right side: large photo of workshop tools/pegboard.
components.stats_row: 4 columns. Large numbers, monoline icon, thin bottom border.
components.product_card: Image aspect 4:3 or 1:1, sharp corners, no card shadow. Clean typography below: Maker name (muted), Product name, Price (bold). Badges (e.g. 'Veteran Owned') as sharp outline tags.
components.dashboard_sidebar: Dense but legible. Dark mode should use '--bg-elevated' for the sidebar and '--bg' for the main content area, with 1px borders separating them.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-accent text-white hover:bg-accent-hover. Secondary/Outline: border-2 border-ink text-ink hover:bg-ink hover:text-white. Sharp corners (rounded-none).
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults but customized with sharp corners, --bg-elevated background, and --border borders. Focus state uses ring-accent.
components.theme_toggle: Sun/Moon icon in the Top Nav right section. Clicking it toggles 'dark' class on <html> and saves preference to localStorage, checking window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') on first load.

motion.hover: Buttons fill/slide effects. Category cards slight border color transition.
motion.page_load_choreography: Staggered fade up for hero: 1. Eyebrow -> 2. H1 -> 3. Body -> 4. CTAs. Hero photo panels slide in diagonally from the right.
motion.icons: Monoline icons can have a slight draw-in or bounce on hover (using framer-motion).

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement these guidelines across the Crafters Market React + Tailwind + Shadcn application. 1. Apply the CSS variables to the global stylesheet. 2. Update `tailwind.config.js` to use the CSS variable colors and new fonts. 3. Modify Shadcn component defaults (border-radius, colors) to match the sharp, editorial look. 4. Redesign the Homepage using the specific component instructions and image URLs provided. 5. Ensure the Theme Toggle is functional and switches the 'dark' class on the HTML tag. 6. Maintain all existing `data-testid` attributes.
